records.name: Regelbrecherin Knackpunkt
records.biography_en: Has discovered that a boundary can be examined from the side where it breaks. Her HyperNorm frame breaks at the point everybody called natural. A dissonant card asks what a kinder boundary might hold instead. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Grenze wurde von ihrer nachgiebigen Seite untersucht.

variant_notes.note_en: Has discovered that a boundary can be examined from the side where it breaks.

records.name: Aktenmumie Laufend
records.biography_en: Has completed the process of becoming the process. His HyperNorm ribbons secure a file whose original purpose has become difficult to reach. A dissonant card asks whether completion can include loosening a band. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Vorgang hat sich in eine ausführende Person überführt.

variant_notes.note_en: Has completed the process of becoming the process.

records.name: Lückengräber Durchaus
records.biography_en: Respects the rule enough to leave its convenient empty part intact. His HyperNorm ring preserves a convenient opening in an otherwise absolute rule. A dissonant card asks whether the opening could belong to anyone else. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Regel bleibt unter Wahrung ihrer nutzbaren Leerstelle bestehen.

variant_notes.note_en: Respects the rule enough to leave its convenient empty part intact.

records.name: Rebellin Eigenzeichen
records.biography_en: Has found her own mark and is still learning where it can belong. Her HyperNorm board offers a mark not yet accepted as proper expression. A dissonant card makes room for the uncertain hand rather than judging the line first. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das eigene Zeichen wartet noch auf einen passenden Ort.

variant_notes.note_en: Has found her own mark and is still learning where it can belong.

records.name: Ordnungswart Rasterfest
records.biography_en: Can make anything manageable once the inconvenient edges have been omitted. His HyperNorm grid arranges the manageable parts into four empty certainties. A dissonant card asks where the rounded edges went during classification. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Ordnung ist hergestellt. Die Ränder wurden nicht erfasst.

variant_notes.note_en: Can make anything manageable once the inconvenient edges have been omitted.

records.name: Konfettiwart Freilauf
records.biography_en: Has liberated the categories and would appreciate help finding the floor. His HyperNorm popper frees the categories from their assigned compartments. A dissonant card offers to help gather the pieces without sorting everyone back into silence. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Befreiung bittet anschließend um Hilfe beim Wiederfinden.

variant_notes.note_en: Has liberated the categories and would appreciate help finding the floor.
